# Repo-owned spdlog snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [gabime/spdlog](https://github.com/gabime/spdlog) at commit `79524ddd08a4ec981b7fea76afd08ee05f83755d`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 177 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original MIT `LICENSE`, including its fmt dependency notice, is retained in full. The matching pinned fmt source and license are tracked beside this directory. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt` with external fmt; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
